description: Machine-readable regression golden set for scripts/foundry/resolve-wikidata.ts. Encodes every past verified resolution verdict (philosophy 61 + formal sciences 44 + CS 23 + ML-foundations 11 + seed-era 13 + natural sciences 41), the manual-selection rulings (decision-log (9) path), the upstream gaps, and the rejected orphan stub. The resolver re-run is maintainer-local (network); the comparison (scripts/foundry/goldenset-check.ts) is fully offline against this file — CI stays network-free.

expectation_semantics.verified + rank1_expected: FAIL if expected_qid absent from candidates; WARN if present but not selected_qid; PASS if selected.
expectation_semantics.verified + manual_path: INFO either way — v3 baseline did not surface these as rank-1; an improvement (expected_qid surfaced/selected) is reported as IMPROVED, absence is v3 parity, never FAIL.
expectation_semantics.upstream_gap: PASS when unresolved/no selection; FAIL if a must_not_select QID is selected; INFO if a new candidate is selected (manual review — upstream may have matured).
